eyebrow: Buffering: size or time, first wins
code:
buffer_size:     5 MB
buffer_interval: 300 seconds

flush triggers when EITHER hits first:
  5 MB accumulated   --> flush
  300s elapsed        --> flush

no shard count to provision. no KCL.
